'''Tarzen Tagge''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], Tarzen Tagge used a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to render aide to a part of Tepasi that had been damaged by [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]], and he came to be regarded as a hero by the world's inhabitants.<ref name="GoI" /> 

During the reconstruction effort on Tepasi, Tagges established the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]], a construction company which he used as a front for a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation. The company was a success and within a few decades, it was competing on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] scale, and TaggeCo's suppliers were soon struggling to meet the company's demand for construction materials. At the suggestion of his brother [[Halven]], Tagge attempted to locate and mine resources, to grant TaggeCo its own supply chain, and he eventually received permission to explore a large group of planets that the Republic had set aside for corporate development. The industries started by Tagge and Halven sparked a boom on Tepasi and the grateful Tepasi government gifted Tarzen with a chain of islands, which were accompanied by a hereditary barony.<ref name="GoI" />
